meta.source: classic-plus-talent-design.md sections 7 to 19, parsed from the per-gate listings
meta.note: All 27 trees present. Twenty-two are parsed from the talent document’s per-gate listings; Fire, Arms, Subtlety, Destruction, and Protection warrior are authored from their prose sections, which describe the changes without a gate listing.

talents.name: Steady Aim
talents.text: Arcane Shot stops clipping your Auto Shot; then Multi-Shot stops; then movement no longer resets the swing timer; then Aimed Shot becomes castable while moving; then Auto Shot keeps firing during Aimed Shot's cast.
talents.note: Steady Aim is the important one. Arms in Section 6 shows the method on a healthy tree. This is the method applied where it is actually needed.

talents.name: Marked Quarry
talents.text: Hunter's Mark shows the target's health to your party; Auto Shots on a marked target cannot be dodged; the mark jumps to the nearest enemy on death; marking no longer breaks Feign Death; a marked target shows on your minimap at any range.
talents.note: Improved Hunter's Mark is deleted as a flat attack power number and its node becomes Marked Quarry.

talents.name: Ranger's Cadence
talents.text: Arcane Shot refunds its cooldown on a critical strike; Multi-Shot applies Serpent Sting to everything it hits; Arcane Shot removes one magic effect; Multi-Shot gains a fourth target; Arcane Shot and Multi-Shot stop sharing a cooldown.
talents.note: Improved Arcane Shot is deleted as a cooldown number, absorbed into Ranger's Cadence.

talents.name: Hawk Eye
talents.text: Concussive Shot and Scatter Shot gain your full ranged range; holding position for 3 seconds extends your range further; you can fire on a marked target you cannot see.
talents.note: Hawk Eye becomes about what range lets you do rather than how much of it you have. Deleted and returned as dividend: Efficiency, Improved Hunter's Mark, Lethal Shots, Improved Arcane Shot, Improved Serpent Sting, Mortal Shots, Barrage, Ranged Weapon Specialization, Hawk Eye's raw range, and Trueshot Aura's party attack power.

talents.name: Bullseye
talents.text: Aimed Shot can be released early for reduced damage; Aimed Shot cannot be resisted.
talents.note: Arms in Section 6 shows the method on a healthy tree. This is the method applied where it is actually needed.

talents.name: Aimed Shot
talents.text: An aimed shot that increases ranged damage by 70.
talents.note: Kept from vanilla. Arms in Section 6 shows the method on a healthy tree. This is the method applied where it is actually needed.

talents.name: Killing Instinct
talents.text: Aimed Shot refreshes Hunter's Mark; it cannot be dodged or parried; it does not break your own trap; a killing blow with it refunds its mana; it resets Scatter Shot.
talents.note: Arms in Section 6 shows the method on a healthy tree. This is the method applied where it is actually needed.

talents.name: Distracting Fire
talents.text: Concussive Shot may stun; the slow spreads to one nearby enemy; a stunned target cannot regain movement speed for 4 seconds.
talents.note: Arms in Section 6 shows the method on a healthy tree. This is the method applied where it is actually needed.

talents.name: Venomshot
talents.text: Serpent Sting ticks twice as fast below 20% health; it cannot be dispelled; it spreads on death; it applies through immunities to poison; refreshing carries remaining damage forward.
talents.note: Arms in Section 6 shows the method on a healthy tree. This is the method applied where it is actually needed.

talents.name: Ranger's Focus
talents.text: Standing still builds Focus stacks that empower your next Aimed Shot; stacks persist through one movement; they are not lost on a miss; they double during Rapid Fire; a full stack makes the next Aimed Shot instant.
talents.note: Arms in Section 6 shows the method on a healthy tree. This is the method applied where it is actually needed.

talents.name: Scatter Shot
talents.text: A short range shot that deals 50% wepon damage and disorients the target for 4 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect. Turns off your attack when used.
talents.note: Kept from vanilla. Arms in Section 6 shows the method on a healthy tree. This is the method applied where it is actually needed.

talents.name: Pack Tactics
talents.text: Your pet's Bite and Claw gain your ranged critical strike chance; your pet gains your Hunter's Mark bonus; your pet's critical strikes refresh Serpent Sting on its target.
talents.note: Pack Tactics is the node a Beast Mastery hunter crosses for, reachable at 21 points invested.

talents.name: Sure Shot
talents.text: Your ranged attacks can no longer miss or be resisted.
talents.note: Arms in Section 6 shows the method on a healthy tree. This is the method applied where it is actually needed.

talents.name: Volley Discipline
talents.text: Volley may be channelled while moving; Volley applies Hunter's Mark to everything it hits; a Volley tick refreshes Serpent Sting.
talents.note: Arms in Section 6 shows the method on a healthy tree. This is the method applied where it is actually needed.

talents.name: Rapid Killing
talents.text: Rapid Fire's cooldown drops on a killing blow; it no longer costs mana; it extends when you critically strike; it grants your party your Auto Shot speed for 5 seconds; using it resets Aimed Shot.
talents.note: Arms in Section 6 shows the method on a healthy tree. This is the method applied where it is actually needed.

talents.name: Trueshot
talents.text: Your Aimed Shot loses its cast time entirely, but can only be fired after three consecutive Auto Shots have landed.
talents.note: Trueshot Aura sits at gate 30. It is also the entire reason the spec is mandatory: guides state plainly that Beast Mastery loses Trueshot Aura and therefore hurts the whole party's damage.

Marksmanship.rationale: Arms in Section 6 shows the method on a healthy tree. This is the method applied where it is actually needed.

talents.name: Improved Aspect of the Hawk
talents.text: While Aspect of the Hawk is active, all normal ranged attacks have a 1/2/3/4/5% chance of increasing ranged attack speed by 30% for 12 sec.
talents.note: Kept from vanilla, unchanged. Eleven of sixteen nodes are pet statistics: health, armor, damage, critical strike, focus regeneration, movement speed. Demonology's disease, one class over, and with the same consequence: the four pet families are one pet with different art.

talents.text: Send your pet into a rage causing 50% additional damage for 18 sec. While enraged, the beast does not feel pity or remorse or fear and it cannot be stopped unless killed.
talents.note: Kept from vanilla, unchanged. Eleven of sixteen nodes are pet statistics: health, armor, damage, critical strike, focus regeneration, movement speed. Demonology's disease, one class over, and with the same consequence: the four pet families are one pet with different art.

talents.note: The one tree in the game whose own class guides call it the worst and advise against playing it. Its content is traps and defence, neither of which vanilla raids reward, and it carries the most mode-locked nodes after Protection warrior.

talents.name: Stormbringer
talents.text: Windfury can proc from an extra attack once per swing; its proc rate stops scaling down with weapon speed; a proc refreshes your weapon imbue duration; two procs in a row make your next Shock free; a proc grants a stack that increases the next one's damage.
talents.note: Windfury can proc from an extra attack once per swing; its proc rate stops scaling down with weapon speed; a proc refreshes your weapon imbue duration; two procs in a row make your next Shock free; a proc grants a stack that increases the next one's damage. Tied with Demonology for the worst tree in the game at 28 of 30 forced flat, and the flattest tree anywhere at 94%. Nineteen of the first twenty points must buy numbers, so an Enhancement splash is very close to pure filler.

talents.name: Totemic Focus
talents.text: Reduces the Mana cost of your totems by 5/10/15/20/25%.
talents.note: The last rank of Totemic Focus is the single highest-value line in this rebuild.

talents.name: Elemental Cadence
talents.text: Earth Shock leaves the Flame and Frost Shock cooldown alone; a Shock within 3 seconds of a Windfury proc costs no mana; Frost Shock also slows attack speed; Flame Shock spreads to a second target on your next proc; Shocks no longer clip your swing.
talents.note: Tied with Demonology for the worst tree in the game at 28 of 30 forced flat, and the flattest tree anywhere at 94%. Nineteen of the first twenty points must buy numbers, so an Enhancement splash is very close to pure filler.

talents.name: Charged
talents.text: Lightning Shield orbs are consumed by your attacks as well as by being hit; losing an orb refunds mana; at full orbs your next Shock chains to a second target.
talents.note: Tied with Demonology for the worst tree in the game at 28 of 30 forced flat, and the flattest tree anywhere at 94%. Nineteen of the first twenty points must buy numbers, so an Enhancement splash is very close to pure filler.

talents.name: Guardian Totems
talents.text: Stoneskin also shortens movement-impairing effects; Windwall reflects one ranged attack every 10 seconds.
talents.note: Tied with Demonology for the worst tree in the game at 28 of 30 forced flat, and the flattest tree anywhere at 94%. Nineteen of the first twenty points must buy numbers, so an Enhancement splash is very close to pure filler.

talents.name: Improved Ghost Wolf
talents.text: Ghost Wolf becomes instant; then usable in combat.
talents.note: Tied with Demonology for the worst tree in the game at 28 of 30 forced flat, and the flattest tree anywhere at 94%. Nineteen of the first twenty points must buy numbers, so an Enhancement splash is very close to pure filler.

talents.name: Weapon Mastery
talents.text: Effect determined by equipped weapon, the same fork pattern used in Arms and in Bladedancer. Two-handed axes and maces make critical strikes bleed; one hand and shield makes a block generate a Lightning Shield orb; fist and dagger raises Windfury's proc rate.
talents.note: Deleted and returned as dividend: Ancestral Knowledge, Shield Specialization, Thundering Strikes, Improved Lightning Shield, Anticipation, Flurry, Toughness, Weapon Mastery's raw damage.

talents.name: Enhancing Totems
talents.text: Strength of Earth and Grace of Air persist for 10 seconds after leaving their radius; they scale with your weapon imbue; recasting one does not clear its buff from anyone still in range.
talents.note: Tied with Demonology for the worst tree in the game at 28 of 30 forced flat, and the flattest tree anywhere at 94%. Nineteen of the first twenty points must buy numbers, so an Enhancement splash is very close to pure filler.

talents.name: Static Charge
talents.text: Critical strikes add an orb to Lightning Shield; orbs beyond maximum become damage; crits refresh your weapon imbue; at full orbs a crit discharges one at a nearby enemy; a crit within 3 seconds of a Windfury proc grants another proc.
talents.note: Static Charge is what replaces Flurry: the crit-driven feedback loop stays, but it feeds a mechanic instead of a percentage.

talents.name: Ancestral Guidance
talents.text: Healing Wave no longer stops your swing; Lesser Healing Wave may be cast while moving; healing a target grants them your Lightning Shield's next discharge; your heals generate no threat while a totem of yours is active; overhealing becomes attack power for 6 seconds.
talents.note: Tied with Demonology for the worst tree in the game at 28 of 30 forced flat, and the flattest tree anywhere at 94%. Nineteen of the first twenty points must buy numbers, so an Enhancement splash is very close to pure filler.

talents.name: Elemental Weapons
talents.text: Your weapon imbues also add spell damage; Flame and Frost Shock scale with it; your Lightning Bolt may be cast while your swing timer is running.
talents.note: Worth its points to any shaman who imbues a weapon, which is all of them, and worth most to an Elemental main at 26/25.

talents.name: Improved Weapon Totems
talents.text: Windfury Totem also grants its attack power to you while you are within range of it; its proc can trigger from an extra attack; Flametongue Totem applies your weapon imbue to the party; a totem you drop refreshes the imbue on everyone in range.
talents.note: Improved Weapon Totems now at least lets the shaman benefit from the totem they are carrying for everyone else, which is a small correction to the third failure mode rather than a solution to it.

talents.name: Earthbound
talents.text: Your totems become immune to damage and last twice as long. You may have only one totem active at a time.
talents.note: Tied with Demonology for the worst tree in the game at 28 of 30 forced flat, and the flattest tree anywhere at 94%. Nineteen of the first twenty points must buy numbers, so an Enhancement splash is very close to pure filler.

talents.name: Windfury Mastery
talents.text: Windfury's extra attacks use your main hand's full damage; they can critically strike; they generate no threat; they refresh Flame Shock; a proc during Stormstrike's window adds a third attack.
talents.note: Tied with Demonology for the worst tree in the game at 28 of 30 forced flat, and the flattest tree anywhere at 94%. Nineteen of the first twenty points must buy numbers, so an Enhancement splash is very close to pure filler.

talents.note: Kept from vanilla. Tied with Demonology for the worst tree in the game at 28 of 30 forced flat, and the flattest tree anywhere at 94%. Nineteen of the first twenty points must buy numbers, so an Enhancement splash is very close to pure filler.

talents.note: Concussion, Convection, Call of Thunder, Reverberation, and Lightning Mastery all modify Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning.

talents.name: Storm Reach
talents.text: Moved up. Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning gain range; Chain Lightning jumps further between targets.
talents.note: Twenty-three of thirty forced flat, and a gate-20 tier holding three points, the second-sparsest hybrid seat in the game after Feral. Concussion, Convection, Call of Thunder, Reverberation, and Lightning Mastery all modify Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning.

talents.name: Elemental Warding

talents.note: Three more, Call of Flame, Earth's Grasp, and Improved Fire Totems, modify totems nobody drops.

talents.note: Twenty of fifty-two points are mana cost and healing percentage on one spell family. Gate 20 holds four points, the sparse-tier problem from REG-18 for the fifth time.

talents.name: Healing Grace

talents.note: Kept from vanilla, unchanged. Twenty of fifty-two points are mana cost and healing percentage on one spell family. Gate 20 holds four points, the sparse-tier problem from REG-18 for the fifth time.

talents.name: Bound Servant
talents.text: Your demon inherits your resistances; then your armor; then it survives your death; then it returns at 30% health thirty seconds after dying; then summoning costs no shard.
talents.note: Tied with Enhancement for the worst tree in the game at 28 of 30 forced flat. Unlike Enhancement, this one also fails at the thing it is named after.

talents.name: Familiar

talents.note: Tied with Enhancement for the worst tree in the game at 28 of 30 forced flat. Unlike Enhancement, this one also fails at the thing it is named after.

talents.name: Soulcraft

talents.note: Tied with Enhancement for the worst tree in the game at 28 of 30 forced flat. Unlike Enhancement, this one also fails at the thing it is named after.

talents.name: Soul Tether
talents.text: Health Funnel channels while you cast; your demon's damage returns health to you; a demon at full health funnels back to you instead; Health Funnel on a full demon becomes damage against its target; your demon's regeneration applies to you while it is idle.
talents.note: Tied with Enhancement for the worst tree in the game at 28 of 30 forced flat. Unlike Enhancement, this one also fails at the thing it is named after.

talents.name: Demonic Resilience

talents.note: Tied with Enhancement for the worst tree in the game at 28 of 30 forced flat. Unlike Enhancement, this one also fails at the thing it is named after.

talents.name: Guardian

talents.note: Tied with Enhancement for the worst tree in the game at 28 of 30 forced flat. Unlike Enhancement, this one also fails at the thing it is named after.

talents.name: Fel Domination
talents.text: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, or Felhunter Summon spell has its casting time reduced by 5.5 sec and its mana cost reduced by 50%.
talents.note: And now the spine of the tree rather than a curiosity.

talents.name: Swift Binding
talents.text: Fel Domination's cooldown drops; then it applies to Enslave Demon; then a demon summoned under it arrives at full health; then swapping demons carries your active buffs across; then Fel Domination holds two charges.
talents.note: Swift Binding is where the thesis lands. Tied with Enhancement for the worst tree in the game at 28 of 30 forced flat. Unlike Enhancement, this one also fails at the thing it is named after.

talents.name: Cruelty
talents.text: Succubus's Lash of Pain reduces healing received; Felhunter's Spell Lock silences longer against a target mid-cast; Imp's Fire Shield reflects to a second attacker.
talents.note: Improved Succubus becomes part of Cruelty. Tied with Enhancement for the worst tree in the game at 28 of 30 forced flat. Unlike Enhancement, this one also fails at the thing it is named after.

talents.name: Master Summoner
talents.text: Summoning is instant if your previous demon died within 10 seconds; summoning does not break your current cast.
talents.note: Tied with Enhancement for the worst tree in the game at 28 of 30 forced flat. Unlike Enhancement, this one also fails at the thing it is named after.

talents.name: Demonic Empowerment
talents.text: Each demon gains a command you can trigger. The Imp becomes a charge you detonate; the Voidwalker taunts everything near it; the Succubus vanishes and re-engages behind its target; the Felhunter devours one beneficial effect. The fifth rank takes the command off the global cooldown.
talents.note: Tied with Enhancement for the worst tree in the game at 28 of 30 forced flat. Unlike Enhancement, this one also fails at the thing it is named after.

talents.name: Demonic Sacrifice
talents.text:
When activated, sacrifices your summoned demon to grant you an effect that lasts 30 min. The effect is canceled if any Demon is summoned.

Imp: Increases your Fire damage by 15%.

Voidwalker: Restores 3% of your total Health every 4 sec.

Succubus: Increases your Shadow damage by 15%.

Felhunter: Restores 2% of total Mana every 4 sec.
talents.note: The two canonical raid builds are SM/Ruin and DS/Ruin, and DS/Ruin takes exactly 21 points here to reach Demonic Sacrifice at gate 20, a talent that kills the demon in exchange for a damage buff.

talents.name: Shadow Bond
talents.text: Your demon's damage benefits from your curses; your Corruption refreshes on any target your demon damages; your demon's critical strikes extend Siphon Life.
talents.note: Every warlock has Corruption, so it is worth its points alone, and worth most to an Affliction main at 26/25.

talents.name: Ashen Pact
talents.text: Your demon's attacks apply your Immolate's fire damage; Conflagrate does not consume Immolate while your demon is on the target; Searing Pain from you draws no threat if your demon is attacking.
talents.note: Tied with Enhancement for the worst tree in the game at 28 of 30 forced flat. Unlike Enhancement, this one also fails at the thing it is named after.

talents.name: Unbound
talents.text: Your summoned demon gains a second ability drawn from its family, and commands you issue it cost no global cooldown.
talents.note: Tied with Enhancement for the worst tree in the game at 28 of 30 forced flat. Unlike Enhancement, this one also fails at the thing it is named after.

talents.name: Master Demonologist
talents.text:
Grants both the Warlock and the summoned demon an effect as long as the demon is active.

Imp - Reduces threat caused by 4/8/12/16/20%.

Voidwalker - Reduces physical damage taken by 2/4/6/8/10%.

Succubus - Increases all damage caused by 2/4/6/8/10%.

Felhunter - Increases all resistances by 0.2/0.4/0.6/0.8/1 per level.
talents.note: Master Demonologist gives a different effect per demon, which is the one node in the tree that treats the four demons as different rather than as one pet with different art.

talents.name: Soul Link
talents.text: When active, 30% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, or Felhunter demon instead. In addition, both the demon and master will inflict 3% more damage. Lasts as long as the demon is active.
talents.note: Tied with Enhancement for the worst tree in the game at 28 of 30 forced flat. Unlike Enhancement, this one also fails at the thing it is named after.

Demonology.rationale: Tied with Enhancement for the worst tree in the game at 28 of 30 forced flat. Unlike Enhancement, this one also fails at the thing it is named after.

talents.name: Suppression
talents.text: Your damage-over-time effects cannot be dispelled at rank 3, and cannot be resisted on application at rank 5.
talents.note: Seventeen nodes, and five of them modify curses that a raid warlock casts once. Improved Curse of Exhaustion takes four points at gate 20, in the hybrid seat, on a movement slow.

talents.name: Improved Corruption
talents.text: From cast time: Corruption applies instantly at rank 1, then refreshes on your Shadow Bolt, then ticks faster below 20%, then spreads on death, then carries remaining damage forward when refreshed.
talents.note: Seventeen nodes, and five of them modify curses that a raid warlock casts once. Improved Curse of Exhaustion takes four points at gate 20, in the hybrid seat, on a movement slow.

talents.name: Improved Drain Soul
talents.text: Gives you a 50/100% chance to get a 100% increase to your Mana regeneration for 10 sec if the target is killed by you while you drain its soul. In addition your Mana may continue to regenerate while casting at 50% of normal.
talents.note: Kept from vanilla, unchanged. Seventeen nodes, and five of them modify curses that a raid warlock casts once. Improved Curse of Exhaustion takes four points at gate 20, in the hybrid seat, on a movement slow.

talents.name: Siphon
talents.text: Merging the drain talents: Drain Life and Drain Mana channel while you move, then do not break on damage, then benefit from your shadow damage, then apply Corruption, then refund a shard on a killing blow.
talents.note: The spine is Nightfall, Siphon Life, Dark Pact, Improved Drain Soul, and Shadow Mastery.

talents.name: Curse Mastery
talents.text: Two curses may be active at once, then curses cannot be dispelled, then a curse refreshes on your damage-over-time ticks, then Amplify Curse has no cooldown, then curses apply to everything Corruption is on.
talents.note: Improved Curse of Weakness, Improved Curse of Agony, Curse of Exhaustion, and Improved Curse of Exhaustion deleted, their effects folded into Curse Mastery.

talents.name: Fel Concentration

talents.note: Kept from vanilla, unchanged. Seventeen nodes, and five of them modify curses that a raid warlock casts once. Improved Curse of Exhaustion takes four points at gate 20, in the hybrid seat, on a movement slow.

talents.name: Amplify Curse
talents.text: Increases the effect of your next Curse of Weakness or Curse of Agony by 50%, or your next Curse of Exhaustion by 20%. Lasts 30 sec.
talents.note: Kept from vanilla, unchanged. Seventeen nodes, and five of them modify curses that a raid warlock casts once. Improved Curse of Exhaustion takes four points at gate 20, in the hybrid seat, on a movement slow.

talents.name: Grim Reach

talents.note: Seventeen nodes, and five of them modify curses that a raid warlock casts once. Improved Curse of Exhaustion takes four points at gate 20, in the hybrid seat, on a movement slow.

talents.note: Kept from vanilla, unchanged. Seventeen nodes, and five of them modify curses that a raid warlock casts once. Improved Curse of Exhaustion takes four points at gate 20, in the hybrid seat, on a movement slow.

talents.name: Emberlink

talents.name: Backdraft

talents.note: Subtraction node at gate 20, Backdraft: Conflagrate loses its cooldown and you may no longer cast Shadow Bolt.

talents.name: Bloodletting
talents.text: Rake and Rip ignore armor; Rip dumps its remaining damage on a killing blow; bleeds tick twice as fast below 20%; refreshing carries damage forward; a bleeding target cannot restealth.

talents.name: Impact
talents.text: Gives your Fire spells a 2/4/6/8/10% chance to stun the target for 2 sec.
talents.note: Impact, Ignite, Burning Soul, Pyroblast, Improved Fire Ward, Improved Scorch, Master of Elements, Blast Wave, and Combustion are all behavior. Your Fire damage has a chance to stun the target, and the rebuild leaves it alone.

talents.name: Flame Throwing
talents.text: Rank one extends the range of your Fire spells; rank two lets Scorch be cast while moving.
talents.note: Reworked to discrete ranks. Only Improved Fireball, Flame Throwing, Improved Fire Blast, Improved Flamestrike, Incinerate, Critical Mass, and Fire Power are flat, and several are two or three ranks rather than five. Flame Throwing and Improved Fire Blast get discrete ranks.

talents.name: Ignite
talents.text: Critical strikes leave the target burning, and the ranks stay as written.
talents.note: Impact, Ignite, Burning Soul, Pyroblast, Improved Fire Ward, Improved Scorch, Master of Elements, Blast Wave, and Combustion are all behavior.

talents.name: Improved Fire Blast
talents.text: The cooldown drops, then Fire Blast applies Ignite, then it spreads Ignite to a second target.
talents.note: Reworked to discrete ranks. Only Improved Fireball, Flame Throwing, Improved Fire Blast, Improved Flamestrike, Incinerate, Critical Mass, and Fire Power are flat, and several are two or three ranks rather than five. Flame Throwing and Improved Fire Blast get discrete ranks.

talents.name: Incinerate
talents.text: Scorch and Fire Blast gain critical strike chance against a burning target.
talents.note: Only Improved Fireball, Flame Throwing, Improved Fire Blast, Improved Flamestrike, Incinerate, Critical Mass, and Fire Power are flat, and several are two or three ranks rather than five.

talents.name: Improved Flamestrike
talents.text: Increases the critical strike chance of your Flamestrike spell by 5/10/15%.
talents.note: Kept from vanilla, with its stun chance intact. Only Improved Fireball, Flame Throwing, Improved Fire Blast, Improved Flamestrike, Incinerate, Critical Mass, and Fire Power are flat, and several are two or three ranks rather than five.

talents.name: Pyroblast
talents.text: The long cast that leaves a burn behind it.
talents.note: Impact, Ignite, Burning Soul, Pyroblast, Improved Fire Ward, Improved Scorch, Master of Elements, Blast Wave, and Combustion are all behavior.

talents.name: Burning Soul
talents.text: Your Fire spells become harder to push back and generate less threat.
talents.note: Impact, Ignite, Burning Soul, Pyroblast, Improved Fire Ward, Improved Scorch, Master of Elements, Blast Wave, and Combustion are all behavior.

talents.name: Improved Scorch
talents.text: Scorch applies a stacking Fire vulnerability.
talents.note: Impact, Ignite, Burning Soul, Pyroblast, Improved Fire Ward, Improved Scorch, Master of Elements, Blast Wave, and Combustion are all behavior.

talents.name: Improved Fire Ward
talents.text: Fire Ward reflects a portion of what it absorbs.
talents.note: Impact, Ignite, Burning Soul, Pyroblast, Improved Fire Ward, Improved Scorch, Master of Elements, Blast Wave, and Combustion are all behavior.

talents.name: Master of Elements
talents.text: A critical strike refunds its mana, which is behavior rather than a percentage.
talents.note: Impact, Ignite, Burning Soul, Pyroblast, Improved Fire Ward, Improved Scorch, Master of Elements, Blast Wave, and Combustion are all behavior.

talents.name: Frostfire
talents.text: Your Fire spells apply Chill, Fire Blast benefits from your Frost damage, and a Frozen target takes Ignite at double rate.
talents.note: New at gate 20. Every mage has Frostbolt, so it stands alone.

talents.name: Firewalker
talents.text: Your Fire spells cannot be resisted and Ignite never falls off. You may no longer cast Frost or Arcane spells.
talents.note: New at gate 20. Eight forced flat, the healthiest tree in the game, and the one that argues against this document. Impact, Ignite, Burning Soul, Pyroblast, Improved Fire Ward, Improved Scorch, Master of Elements, Blast Wave, and Combustion are all behavior.

talents.name: Blast Wave
talents.text: The instant that damages and dazes everything around you.
talents.note: Impact, Ignite, Burning Soul, Pyroblast, Improved Fire Ward, Improved Scorch, Master of Elements, Blast Wave, and Combustion are all behavior.

talents.name: Critical Mass
talents.text: Rather than raising critical chance, a Fire critical now shortens your next Pyroblast, then guarantees Ignite, then makes the next one instant.
talents.note: Only Improved Fireball, Flame Throwing, Improved Fire Blast, Improved Flamestrike, Incinerate, Critical Mass, and Fire Power are flat, and several are two or three ranks rather than five. Improved Fireball, Critical Mass, and Fire Power go to the dividend.

talents.name: Combustion
talents.text: Fire criticals accumulate until one lands, and the capstone stays exactly as it was.
talents.note: Impact, Ignite, Burning Soul, Pyroblast, Improved Fire Ward, Improved Scorch, Master of Elements, Blast Wave, and Combustion are all behavior.
